# Membrane RTSP v0.12.1 - Table of Contents

> RTSP client for Elixir

## Pages

- [Membrane RTSP](https://membrane-rtsp.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://membrane-rtsp.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.RTSP](https://membrane-rtsp.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTSP.md): Functions for interfacing with a RTSP session

- [Membrane.RTSP.Request](https://membrane-rtsp.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTSP.Request.md): This module represents a RTSP 1.0 request.

- [Membrane.RTSP.Response](https://membrane-rtsp.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTSP.Response.md): This module represents a RTSP response.

- RTSP Server
  - [Membrane.RTSP.Server](https://membrane-rtsp.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTSP.Server.md): Implementation of an RTSP server.
  - [Membrane.RTSP.Server.Handler](https://membrane-rtsp.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTSP.Server.Handler.md): Behaviour describing client request handling for Real Time Streaming Protocol.
